description: This file contains functions for processing Markdown content, extracting translatable segments, and applying translations. It uses the Goldmark library to parse Markdown and identify translatable blocks, such as paragraphs, headings, and list items, for localization purposes.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Parses Markdown content to extract translatable segments, returning their positions, text, hashes, and segment IDs.

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Reconstructs the original Markdown content with translated segments applied.
